changeSet.author: tchoi
changeSet.comment: Point files saved through the Egnyte file store back at the current local file store root. Those files are marked external and point at the Egnyte root, which the local store cannot resolve. Their local copy was never deleted (InternalFileStoreImpl.removeFile does nothing), and relPath is the path under both roots, so they resolve to that copy again. Runs only when exactly one local root is current, so it never guesses a root or leaves no current root. The Egnyte FileStoreRoot row is kept, no longer current, as a record of where the files were in Egnyte.
changeSet.sql:
update FileProperty fp join (select max(id) as id from FileStoreRoot where current = 1 and external = 0 having count(*) = 1) localRoot set fp.external = 0, fp.root_id = localRoot.id where fp.external = 1;
update FileStoreRoot r join (select max(id) as id from FileStoreRoot where current = 1 and external = 0 having count(*) = 1) localRoot set r.current = 0 where r.external = 1;
